decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans 

031-001-ES, Specification & EMAQ Report (dated 07.11.25), 031-001-11, 031-001-13, 031-001-41, 031-001-42, 5878/1000/, Design and Access statement (received 13/11/2025), Overheating assessment (received 01/12/2026), Plant Noise Impact Assessment (dated 3.12.25), 031-001-01, 031-001-03 REV D, 031-001-21 REV C, 031-001-22 REV B, 031-001-23 REVA

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - The external noise level emitted from plant, machinery or equipment at the development hereby approved shall be lower than the typical existing background noise level by at least 10dBA, or by 15dBA where the source is tonal, as assessed according to BS4142:2014 at the nearest and/or most affected noise sensitive premises, with all machinery operating together at maximum capacity.

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 4 - Prior to use, machinery, plant or equipment at the development shall be mounted with proprietary anti-vibration isolators and fan motors shall be vibration-isolated from the casing and adequately silenced and maintained as such. 

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 5 - The plant that is proposed to be removed under this application, shall all be removed from the building within three months of operation of the new plant.  
  
Reason: In order to minimize the impact on the appearance of the building and local environment in accordance with the requirements of policy D1 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017
Condition : 6 - The installation, operation, and maintenance of the odour abatement equipment and extract system, including the height of the extract duct and discharge outlet, shall be in accordance with the 'Odour and Noise from Commercial Kitchen Exhaust Systems' document dated January 2005 and EMAQ+2018 Guidance. The measures shall be installed prior to use of the equipment and thereafter be permanently retained.

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site and surrounding premises is not adversely affected by odour or noise in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London
description: Erection of external plant and ducting on rear elevation and external air-conditioning units
